$description: Design tokens extracted from visual reference board: cozy study-desk aesthetic blending warm editorial library tones with focused late-night ambience and pastel organizational accents.
$sources: inspo/Study Corner Ideas for Small Bedrooms.jpg

color.$description: Dual-mode palette anchored on warm wood tones, amber lamplight, and deep shadow — with a softer cream/pastel alternate mode.

pastel.$description: Pastel sticky-note accent palette from the Study Corner reference.

goldenHour.$description: Sunset gradient from the Londres window backdrop.

warmVignette.$description: Vignette darkening toward edges, simulating lamp falloff.

shelfGlow.$description: Subtle warm under-shelf LED strip glow.

ambientSurface.$description: Quiet dark surface gradient for card backgrounds.

shadows.$description: Warm-tinted shadows that reinforce the lamplight ambience.

typography.$description: Scholarly-yet-cozy type stack — a refined serif display face paired with a crisp humanist sans-serif body.

layout.$description: Bento-grid-inspired layout with asymmetric card arrangements, echoing the layered desk surfaces and corkboard pinning.

borderRadius.$description: Slightly rounded corners echoing the soft edges of notebooks and sticky notes — never harsh or fully square.

materialLanguage.$description: Physical textures to translate into digital surfaces.

hoverGlow.description: Soft warm radial glow on hover, simulating lamplight spilling onto the element.
hoverGlow.css: box-shadow: 0 0 30px rgba(232, 168, 73, 0.12); transform: translateY(-2px); transition: all 0.35s cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1);

cardLift.description: Gentle upward lift with deepening shadow on hover, like lifting a notebook off the desk.
cardLift.css: transform: translateY(-4px); box-shadow: 0 12px 32px rgba(18, 16, 16, 0.2); transition: all 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1);

stickyNotePeel.description: Slight rotation and lift on hover, like peeling a sticky note.
stickyNotePeel.css: transform: rotate(-1.5deg) translateY(-3px) scale(1.02); transition: all 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1);

pageFlip.description: Subtle 3D rotate on horizontal axis for page-like transitions.
pageFlip.css: transform: perspective(800px) rotateX(2deg); transition: transform 0.5s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1);

candleFlicker.description: Gentle pulsing opacity on ambient glow elements.

fadeInUp.description: Content entrance: fade in from below with a warm spring ease.
fadeInUp.keyframes: fadeInUp { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(16px); } to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); } }

components.$description: Primary UI elements identified across the four reference images.

heroCard.description: Large featured content card (span 8+ columns). Full-bleed background image with warm vignette overlay, prominent display-serif headline, and a subtle inner glow border.
heroCard.inspiration: The Londres sunset desktop with layered notebooks and glowing laptop screen.

stickyNoteCard.description: Small square card with pastel background, handwritten-font text, and a slight CSS rotation. Used for quick tips, reminders, or status blurbs.
stickyNoteCard.inspiration: Pastel sticky notes on corkboard and pegboard in Londres and Study Corner.

corkboardPanel.description: A textured panel acting as a pinboard for multiple small items. Cork or linen background with subtle noise texture.
corkboardPanel.inspiration: The corkboard wall in the Londres reference.

glowLampWidget.description: A circular or oval ambient glow element positioned near key content, acting as a warm focal-point light source.
glowLampWidget.inspiration: Desk lamps in all four images — warm light pooling on surfaces.

verticalNavSidebar.description: Narrow dark sidebar navigation with icon-first items and warm amber active indicator.
verticalNavSidebar.inspiration: The vertical bookshelf structure in the Library Workspace.

statusBadge.description: Small inline badge with rounded-full corners, used for labels like 'In Progress', 'Due Today', 'Focus Mode'. Pastel or semantic color background.
statusBadge.inspiration: Colored tabs/bookmarks on textbooks in the Late Night reference.

digitalClockDisplay.description: Prominent clock/timer widget with large monospace numerals on a dark background, subtle inner glow.
digitalClockDisplay.inspiration: The digital clock reading 02:14 AM and the 07:30 display.

progressTracker.description: A weekly-planner-style tracker with day labels and checkbox/progress indicators. To-do list format.
progressTracker.inspiration: The 'Weekly Plan: Mon to Sun' corkboard note and the to-do checklist.

ambientBackdrop.description: Full-viewport background layer with a slow-moving gradient or blurred image, providing the 'window view' atmospheric depth.
ambientBackdrop.inspiration: The sunset/city-light window views in Londres and Late Night.

shelfRow.description: Horizontal scrollable row of book-spine-like items (cards, resources, etc.) with warm under-lighting.
shelfRow.inspiration: The library bookshelves with LED strip lighting in Library Workspace.

notebookEditor.description: A rich-text or markdown area styled like an open spiral notebook — lined or grid background, handwritten feel.
notebookEditor.inspiration: The open notebooks with handwritten notes in Londres and Study Corner.

motivationalBanner.description: A decorative text banner with an inspirational quote, displayed in serif/handwritten typography with gentle animation.
motivationalBanner.inspiration: The 'Dream Big', 'Trust The Process', and 'Breathe. Study. Achieve.' elements.
